title.en: Establish cold-start readiness and steady/1.2RPS/burst SLO matrix
title.zh: 建立冷启动 readiness 与 steady/1.2RPS/burst SLO 矩阵

summary.en: Build a reproducible, publishable production readiness and burst SLO benchmark that clearly separates cold/warm startup costs, steady-state serving capacity, and burst recovery capability.
summary.zh: 建立可重复、可发布的生产 readiness 与突发 SLO benchmark，明确区分冷/热启动成本、稳态服务容量和突发恢复能力。

pr.title: feat(issue-135): readiness SLO matrix schema, validator, aggregator a…

progress_summary.en: Schema + semantic validator enforce fail-closed constraints. The aggregator combines N >= 3 repetitions with median/IQR + 1.5*IQR outlier mask. The shell runner orchestrates the workload x load_profile x repetition matrix. 70 new tests added.
progress_summary.zh: Schema + 语义校验器强制 fail-closed 约束。聚合器对 N >= 3 次重复使用中位数/IQR + 1.5*IQR 异常值掩码。Shell runner 编排 workload x load_profile x repetition 矩阵。新增 70 个测试。

title.en: Make Docker NPU jobs compatible with the self-hosted runner watchdog
title.zh: 使 Docker NPU 作业兼容自托管 runner watchdog

summary.en: Add runner ownership labels and single-card device mapping to every Docker NPU container launched via the host Docker socket, making them compatible with the self-hosted runner watchdog.
summary.zh: 为通过宿主机 Docker socket 启动的每个 Docker NPU 容器添加 runner 归属 label 和单卡设备映射，使其兼容自托管 runner watchdog。

pr.title: feat(infra): enforce watchdog ownership for Docker NPU jobs

progress_summary.en: Runner ownership resolution, docker create command construction with labels and device mapping, and inspect validation (fail-closed) implemented. 40 tests cover runner resolution, command construction, and inspect validation. Validation on the intended self-hosted NPU runner class remains pending.
progress_summary.zh: 已实现 runner 归属解析、带 label 和设备映射的 docker create 命令构造，以及 inspect 校验（fail-closed）。40 个测试覆盖 runner 解析、命令构造和 inspect 校验；目标自托管 NPU runner 类型上的验证仍待完成。
